name: vaul
title: Vaul
responsibility: Drawer component — draggable bottom sheets and side drawers on Radix Dialog semantics. Mobile-first panels that can be dragged closed.
reachFor: Filter/action panels that users dismiss by dragging
avoid: Centered modals/dialogs — shadcn Dialog already covers that
Non-modal slide-ins without drag semantics — plain motion panels suffice
reactWiring: Drawer.Root/Trigger/Portal/Content/Footer — Radix-compatible API; snap points via snap={[…]}; repositionInputs for mobile keyboards
